# InQsi

InQsi is a global sports market intelligence platform.

## Public products
- ARB: find mathematical sports arbitrage opportunities using compatible sportsbook prices.
- Slip Scanner: analyze market, price and available sports-intelligence risk around a user-selected wager.

## Product boundary
InQsi does not publish its private prediction systems as a public picks product. Qualified private models may provide underlying intelligence to Slip Scanner.

## Coverage
Coverage is global and provider-driven. InQsi normalizes available sports, countries, competitions, events, markets and sportsbooks. A sport or competition should only be described as supported when current provider data confirms it.

## Primary public routes
- /arbitrage-v2
- /arbitrage-v2/calculator
- /parlay-scanner
- /pricing
- /learn/arbitrage

## Data integrity
InQsi does not substitute sample opportunities, prices or model outputs for unavailable live data. Time-sensitive claims should be verified from current visible product data.
